verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes the workers-sdk (Wrangler CLI, the workerd-based Miniflare simulator) on GitHub, giving visibility into the developer tooling and local runtime simulator, but the evidence never states a license and the actual hosted Workers execution platform (the edge runtime service) remains a proprietary Cloudflare service, not something a user can read the full source of. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license statement, confirmation that the production Workers runtime (not just the local simulator) source is published, and independent corroboration of openness.
